host_about:
Mother and Son in Porto, Portugal - improving the art of hospitality

Welcome to our self-catered apartments!
 
Located on the historical center of Oporto, in the heart of a UNESCO World Heritage Center, you'll find a building that belongs to our family for four generations.
 
After my mother (Lu'is grandmother) passed away in 2010 I inherited this building and found a really degraded space with a lot of structural problems and fierce tenants.
 
Having one apartment vacant me and my sons decided to refurbish the entire apartment and prepare it with all the needed amenities for a modern and cozy experience.
 
And we decided to rent it for tourists.
 
The first of our apartments came to daylight in May 2012. Our yellow apartment.
 
The experience was so overwhelming with massive bookings and great reviews that we decided to "tackle" the rest of the building.
 
And so we did.
 
In October 2012 the building went to major refurbishment works with all the structural, electricity, plumbing and communications being changed.
 
We repaired all the commons spaces, painted all the walls and ceilings, changed the windows, repaired and changed the floors, changed all the bathrooms and kitchens while maintaining at the same time all the qualities that give this building it’s finesse.
 
There wasn't a single square inch that we didn't touch!
  
The rest of the apartments came to the market in June 2013 and the bookings went sky high!
 
Right now we have 9 apartments: Blue (6 pax), Yellow (4 pax), Green (2 pax), Pink (2), Brown (2), Orange (2), White (2) , Grey (2) and Red (2)

Again all the critics are excellent with major emphasis on the quality of the apartments and the warm welcomes that both I and my son Luís provide.
 
This is a family business made with love and with respect for the guests that come here.
 
We want you to feel at home in a foreign place and we like to consider you as more than guests.
 
You are our friends that come to visit our beautiful city.
 
Be prepared to a personalized check in, with our mostly enjoyed briefing on sightseeing, Oporto History and local tips!
 
So, enjoy our apartments!
 
Eugénia, October 2019

A small town, with the benefits of a big city.
Espinho, Espinho, a beautifull city ! Espinho, Espinho, a city on the sea shore… - so does a song begin.
Espinho, a city that emerged more than a hundred years ago. Situated on the sea shore, a few kilometers from Porto (capital of the North, the “place to be” when visiting the country) or Aveiro (the Portuguese Venezia), a city of culture, art, sport, fishing, gastronomy...
The layout and numeration of the streets is another of its unusual caracteristics, a “grid city”, with pair numbered streets parallel to the ocean and unpair numbered strees perpendicular to it. This origined its surname “the Portuguese New York”.
In Espinho, time runs out following the rythm and taste of the Atlantic Ocean.
A city calm and plane, that allows long walks for the young, and less youngs, in any kind of form, always near the Ocean.
The gastronomy will be perhaps among the greatest gains, with plenty of restaurants doing marve

neighborhood_overview: This studio is located in a peculiar street of Porto downtown. It is an ancient and  narrow street that ends in a small XVIII century chapel told to be designed by the architect Nicolau Nasoni, the same responsible for the Clérigos Tower, one of the ex-libris of this city. The Rua do Pinheiro street preserves mostly of its original aspect. In it you can find old buildings, renewed buildings, an ancient bookbinding shop (one of the last in the city), an immigration support center and a small grocery store. This means that in this street you can find a variety of people: the ancient and typical residents, the new and trendy residents, tourists (the ones hosted in the street and the others that pass by), and the migrants of all parts of the world that search for the services of the immigration center (which ad a colour and a cosmopolitan touch to this old street). On the side of the chapel there are granite stairs that lead to where everything happens after the sunset: restaurants and bar

This area offers a rich blend of history and culture, with landmarks like the Church of São Pedro de Miragaia and the small but picturesque Jardim da Cordoaria. The neighbourhood's riverside location is great for leisurely walks and the city's vibrant atmosphere.

Visitors to Miragaia can also explore its local shops, cafes, and traditional restaurants, which offer an authentic taste of Porto's culinary heritage. The neighbourhood's proximity to Porto's main attractions, such as the iconic Ribeira district and the Dom Luís I Bridge, makes it a convenient and attractive destination for tourists looking to experience the city's unique blend of old-world charm and modern vibrancy.

This spacious, comfortable and stylishly decorated apartment for up to 4 people with garage, lift and two bathrooms, is located just 120 meters/2 minutes walking from Marquês Metro Station (with connection to the Airport).
With all the comfort and an optimal location close to the metro, it is an excellent option to start your Porto discovery.
neighborhood_overview:
The apartment benefits from its privileged location in the centre of Porto, and gives access by foot to all points of interest downtown. It is located in Rua de Santa Catarina, the most important shopping street in Porto. There are numerous clothing and shoes stores, perfectly coexisting with old bookstores, exquisite coffee shops like Café Majestic, as well as appealing pastry shops.

Adjacent to this area, there is the old town and Ribeira area, classified as UNESCO world heritage site, full of old historical buildings, with the Porto Cathedral and amazing views of the Douro river and its bridges, among which stands the famous D. Luís I bridge. The apartment is at a short walk from Avenida dos Aliados, one of the city's most emblematic places its political and cultural center, which is filled with monumental 19th and early 20th-century’s buildings. Also close, the Clérigos Tower, probably the most iconic building of the city, and Lello Bookshop, also known as Harry Potter`s

description:
New apartment in historic building 100% renovated.
Amazing location and views of the Clérigos Tower, for an unforgettable stay!
In the historical center of UNESCO, facing the Clérigos Tower, 2 walking minutes from the main attractions: Livraria Lello, Aliados Avenue, Rua das Flores, Ribeira.

neighborhood_overview:

With a privileged view of the emblematic Clérios church and town, it is also close to the Lello Library, São Bento Train Station and the entire historical center of the city, offering tranquility and security with a premium location with all the important monuments, squares and pictures just 5 walking minutes away.

An excellent choice for those who come for a holiday or work.

Porto City Hosts is a locally based tourism team consisting of proud Porto citizens. 
We receive our guests with local charm and professional quality. We make our guests feel well accompanied during their stay, helping them to enjoy unforgettable tourist experiences with the confidence of having a team focused on their well being!
We also are passionate travelers eager to find out new places, to know new cultures, landscapes, palates, and smells. We like to introduce our city of Porto, sharing suggestions with new sensations, lived in the first person.
There are walks by the sea, boat cruises on the UNESCO World Heritage Douro river walk through the old Porto streets. 
You can listen to orchestras at the House of Music, smell the books at the Lello bookstore, where the Harry Potter writer was inspired, visit the cellars and drink Port wine, eat Francesinha, tripas à moda do Porto, bacalhau or visit the farms where the grapes are harvested to produce the idyllic Porto!
It will be a pleasure to host you.

host_about:
Mother and Son in Porto, Portugal - improving the art of hospitality

Welcome to our self-catered apartments!
 
Located on the historical center of Oporto, in the heart of a UNESCO World Heritage Center, you'll find a building that belongs to our family for four generations.
 
After my mother (Lu'is grandmother) passed away in 2010 I inherited this building and found a really degraded space with a lot of structural problems and fierce tenants.
 
Having one apartment vacant me and my sons decided to refurbish the entire apartment and prepare it with all the needed amenities for a modern and cozy experience.
 
And we decided to rent it for tourists.
 
The first of our apartments came to daylight in May 2012. Our yellow apartment.
 
The experience was so overwhelming with massive bookings and great reviews that we decided to "tackle" the rest of the building.
 
And so we did.
 
In October 2012 the building went to major refurbishment works with all the structural, electricity, plumbing and communications being changed.
 
We repaired all the commons spaces, painted all the walls and ceilings, changed the windows, repaired and changed the floors, changed all the bathrooms and kitchens while maintaining at the same time all the qualities that give this building it’s finesse.
 
There wasn't a single square inch that we didn't touch!
  
The rest of the apartments came to the market in June 2013 and the bookings went sky high!
 
Right now we have 9 apartments: Blue (6 pax), Yellow (4 pax), Green (2 pax), Pink (2), Brown (2), Orange (2), White (2) , Grey (2) and Red (2)

Again all the critics are excellent with major emphasis on the quality of the apartments and the warm welcomes that both I and my son Luís provide.
 
This is a family business made with love and with respect for the guests that come here.
 
We want you to feel at home in a foreign place and we like to consider you as more than guests.
 
You are our friends that come to visit our beautiful city.
 
Be prepared to a personalized check in, with our mostly enjoyed briefing on sightseeing, Oporto History and local tips!
 
So, enjoy our apartments!
 
Eugénia, October 2019

neighborhood_overview: Porto soothes the soul. The second city to Lisbon, its completely different in style and vibe. The rich history of the city is woven in to everything you come across, from the food, the wine, the docks and commerce and even its people. It’s the kind of city where people come for a weekend and stay a lifetime. Edgy yet opulent, the city has art on every corner, from galleries and museums to street art to edgy modern art and graffiti installations, each telling the story of a different time and slice of Porto living.
host_about:
Travel is life ! I love meeting people and helping them discover the amazing places I am lucky enough to call home in Portugal, Malta and the UK.  Maybe you will do as I did in 2009 and give up your old life to make one of these magical places home...

When travelling, I believe that paying to stay in a place is a real treat, and when you do so the very least that you should expect is for it to be as comfortable and clean as your own home, if not even better.  

For me, that means spaces that not only look amazing, but also cover the basics that are so often missing in AirBNB properties such as huge beds with fine linens and 100% blackout for a great nights sleep, plus Air Conditioning and Luxury amenities. 

It's these simple luxuries, plus sparkling clean places, great wifi / smart home tech and fast responsive service that I make sure to provide for my guests.

___

Les voyages c'est la vie ! J'aime rencontrer des gens et les aider à découvrir mon incroyable ville Lisbonne, avec sa culture, ses parcs, sa plage, ses magasins et sa gastronomie fantastique ! Peut-être ferez-vous comme moi, qui ai abandonné mon ancienne vie en 2009 pour faire de ce lieu magique mon nouveau chez-moi…

En voyage, je pense que payer pour séjourner quelque part implique d'avoir pour soi un lieu aussi confortable et propre que sa propre maison, voire même mieux. Pour moi, cela veut dire non seulement des espaces époustouflants, mais aussi des éléments de base qui font si souvent défaut aux locations AirBNB, telles que des lits énormes avec une literie fine et une isolation lumineuse parfaite pour une bonne nuit de sommeil, ainsi qu'un équipement de climatisation. Ce sont ces simples luxes que je m'assure de fournir à mes invités.
___
¡Viajar es vida! Me encanta conocer gente y ayudarles a descubrir Lisboa, mi increíble ciudad, donde se puede disfrutar de la cultura, los parques, la playa, las tiendas y la comida fantástica; ¡todo en el mismo día! Tal vez hará lo que yo hice en 2009 y dejará su antigua vida para hacer de este lugar mágico un hogar...

Creo que pagar por alojarse en un lugar mientras viaja es un verdadero placer, y cuando lo hace, lo mínimo que puede esperar es que sea tan cómodo y limpio como su propia casa, o incluso mejor. Para mí, eso significa espacios que no solo tienen un aspecto increíble, sino que también cubren los aspectos básicos que a menudo faltan en las propiedades de AirBNB, tales como camas enormes con sábanas finas y persianas 100% blackout para un buen descanso nocturno, además de aire acondicionado y amenidades lujosas. Son estos simples lujos los que me aseguro de proporcionar a mis invitados cuando soy la anfitriona también.
___
Viaggiare è vita! Amo conoscere gente nuova e aiutare la gente a scoprire Lisbona, la mia splendida città, in cui si può godere di cultura, parchi, spiagge, negozi e di cibo buonissimo – tutto in un solo giorno! 

Forse farete come me nel 2009 quando ho scelto di cambiare vita e di realizzare questo magnifico appartamento…

Quando si viaggia, credo che pagare per alloggiare in un appartamento sia l’ideale e quando lo si fa, il minimo che ci si aspetta è godere del comfort e della pulizia della propria casa o addirittura meglio. Per me significa, non solo appartamenti magnifici ma anche offrire elementi basici che spesso mancano nelle proprietà AirBNB come letti ampi con lenzuola di qualità e serrande in tutta la casa per godere di un ottimo riposo durante la notte, più aria condizionata e servizi di lusso. 

Sono questi i servizi che mi assicuro di offrire ai miei ospiti quando anch’io ospito qualcuno. 
___
Reisen ist Leben! Ich liebe es, Menschen zu treffen und ihnen zu helfen, meine tolle Stadt Lissabon zu entdecken, in der man Kultur, Parks, Strände, Geschäfte und fantastisches Essen genießen kann – alles an einem Tag! Vielleicht werden Sie das tun, was ich 2009 getan habe, und Ihr altes Leben aufgeben, um diesen magischen Ort zu Ihrem neuen Zuhause zu machen …

Wenn ich reise und für die Übernachtung in einer Unterkunft Geld bezahle, dann finde ich, dass das etwas Besonderes ist, und wenn man dies tut, sollte man davon ausgehen können, dass es mindestens so komfortabel und sauber ist wie bei sich zu Hause, oder hoffentlich noch besser. Für mich bedeutet das Räumlichkeiten, die nicht nur toll aussehen, sondern auch die grundlegenden Dinge umfassen, die so oft in Airbnb-Unterkünften fehlen, wie riesige Betten mit guter Bettwäsche und 100% Verdunkelung, um nachts super schlafen zu können, plus Klimatisierung und luxuriöse Annehmlichkeiten. Ich achte darauf, meinen Gästen diese kleinen luxuriösen Details zu bieten, wenn ich selbst Gastgeber bin.
___
Reizen is leven! Ik houd van nieuwe mensen ontmoeten en ze te helpen bij het ontdekken van Lissabon, mijn geweldige stad, een stad vol met cultuur, parken, stranden, winkeltjes en heerlijk lekker eten – en dat allemaal in een dag!!  Misschien geeft u ook wel net als mij uw oude leventje op en maakt u Lissabon tot uw nieuwe thuis… 

Als ik reis vind ik dat als je voor een plek betaald, dat je deze plek dan ten minste net zo comfortabel en schoon zou mouten zijn als je eigen huis, en misschien zelfs wel een klein beetje beter. Voor mij betekent dat plekken er niet alleen geweldig uit moeten zien, maar ook voorzien moeten zijn van de standaarddingen, dingen die vaak ontbreken bij AirBnB-plekken, zoals grote bedden met lekker beddengoed, 100% verduistering voor een goed nachtrust, airconditioning en luxe faciliteiten. Ik zorg dat mijn gasten kunnen genieten van juist deze faciliteiten. 
___
Viajar é vida! Adoro conhecer pessoas e ajudá-las a descobrir Lisboa, a minha cidade maravilhosa, onde pode desfrutar da cultura, parques, praias, lojas e comida fantástica – tudo no mesmo dia!! Talvez faça como eu em 2009 e desista da sua antiga vida para tornar este lugar mágico na sua casa...

Ao viajar, acredito que pagar para ficar num lugar é um verdadeiro benefício, e quando faz isso, o mínimo que deve esperar é que ele seja tão confortável e limpo quanto a sua própria casa ou quem sabe, melhor ainda. Para mim, isso significa sítios que não parecem apenas incríveis mas que também cubram o básico que muitas vezes falta em propriedades Airbnb como camas grandes com bons lençóis de qualidade e persianas para boas noites de sono, além de Ar condicionado e comodidades de luxo. São estes luxos simples que eu garanto aos meus hóspedes quando estou hospedando também. 
___

旅行就是生活!我喜欢结识朋友,并帮助他们发现里斯本 - 这座令我着迷的城市的魅力｡在这里,您用一天时间就可以感受当地文化,游览公园､漫步海滩､开心购物并品味美食!或许,您也会像2009年时的我一样,放弃曾经的生活,把这个梦幻般的城市作为自己的家……

旅行过程中,我认为花钱在所到的城市住店是一种真正的享受｡这样做的时候,您至少应该期待整个过程会让您享有如家般的舒服与整洁,或甚至更好｡对于我而言,花钱住店就意味着所住之处不仅布局美观,还要有爱彼迎网站旅店通常缺失的基本要素,比如放置有精致床上用品的特大号床,能为宾客带来良好夜间睡眠的100%遮光百叶窗,以及空调和豪华便利的居家设施｡而这些并不繁琐的豪华配置,也是我的公寓为宾客必备的｡
____

Podróż jest życiem! Kocham poznawać ludzi i pomagać im odkrywać Lizbonę, moje niesamowite miasto, w którym można cieszyć się kulturą, parkami, plażą, sklepami i fantastycznym jedzeniem - wszystko w tym samym dniu !! Może uczynisz tak, jak ja to zrobiłam w 2009 roku i porzucisz swoje dawne życie, aby w tym magicznym miejscu stworzyć swój dom …

Sądzę, że w trakcie podróży płacąc za miejsce, oczekujesz, że będzie ono tak komfortowe i czyste jak Twój własny dom, lub, mam nadzieję, że okaże się jeszcze lepsze. Dla mnie oznacza to przestrzenie, które nie tylko wyglądają wspaniale, ale obejmują również podstawy, których tak często brakuje w obiektach AirBNB, takich jak ogromne łóżka z cienką pościelą i 100% zaciemnienia zapewniające doskonały sen, a także klimatyzację i luksusowe udogodnienia. To te proste luksusy, które zapewniam moim gościom.
___

Путешествия - это жизнь! Я обожаю встречать новых людей и помогать им исследовать Лиссабон - мой прекрасный город, в котором вы можете насладиться культурой, парками, пляжами, магазинами и потрясающей едой - и всё это в один день! Может, всё закончится тем, что вы сделаете то же, что и я в 2009 году - оставите свою прошлую жизнь, чтобы поселиться в этом волшебном месте...

Я уверена, что платить за проживание в определённом месте в путешествии - настоящее удовольствие, и когда так поступаешь, как минимум надеешься, что это место будет таким же уютным и чистым, как твой собственный дом, если не лучше. Для меня это такое место, которое не просто выглядит потрясающе, но и снабжено всеми бытовыми удобствами, чего зачастую не хватает апартаментам на AirBNB - например, большими кроватями с высококачественным постельным бельём и возможностью полностью закрыть окна, чтобы лучше спать ночью, а также кондиционером и роскошными уборными. Эта простая роскошь - то, что я стремлюсь предоставить своим гостям, когда выступаю в роли хозяйки.

name: Na Travessa Suítes - Quarto Standard Plus
description: With only 8 rooms, Na Travessa Suites was born in 2021, created for those who appreciate urban and modern environments. Located in the heart of the city of Porto, it is characterized by being a unique, welcoming and family space. It is not a Hotel, but a space created by us, where the old lives with the modern. We're happy for you to visit.
neighborhood_overview:
According to the archaeological analysis we did, the foundations of this house will have been built in the mid-19th century and may have been once an ancient casting.

There are documents from the Municipality of Porto, which show that in 1928 the building needed rehabilitation works and that a construction master who lived on Rua de Belomonte asked for authorization to make some improvements.

When we acquired this house in 2017 there was nothing that could be rehabilitated, with the exception of the front facade and a beautiful stone arch on the back facade. Now in 2021 we open this house, rehabilitated, to the city and anyone who wants to visit us. In the front is the same as what has always been, inside it is a unique architecture, where many and many people from many countries will pass. That this house lives on for long centuries is what we wish for, but maybe you will need rehabilitation works there for 2120!

neighborhood_overview:
Tanger Suite is located in one of the most emblematic neighborhoods of Porto, 200 meters from the Serralves Museum of Contemporary Art, next to the city's largest avenue (Avenida da Boavista) and just 15 minutes' walk from the sea.

The Serralves heritage complex has been classified as a "National Monument". The Serralves Museum and Park represent a valuable historical and cultural heritage, comprising the Museum, a project by the architect Álvaro Siza, winner of the Pritzker Prize in 1992, the Casa de Serralves, a unique example of Art Deco architecture, and the Park, designed by French architect Jacques Gréber and awarded in 1997 with the "Henry Ford Prize for the Preservation of the Environment".

The Serralves neighborhood is characterized by the architecture of large classic 19th century villas in dialogue with the architectural design of luxury condominiums recently developed by the most renowned Portuguese architects such as Álvaro Siza and Eduardo Souto Mour

It is also very close to the Super Bock arena pavilhão Rosa Mota (8-minute walk) where the best concerts in the city take place!
Nearby you will find a large Continente supermarket, the Repsol gas station, several restaurants and terraces, shops and even hairdressers. You will also find the stop for the Historic Tram and public transportation such as bus 500, which has a route that goes around and takes you to any area of the city. Enjoy the riverside area by taking beautiful walks to Ribeira or Foz do Douro. If you want to go to the city center, it's close, just go up the beautiful Restauração Street. Enjoy PORTO!
